_source: Hand-written from what the Coral Reef workbook and the design doc ('Level 3: The Coral Reef', its boss and faction sheets) state only in prose; each entry cites its line.
_zone_y_source: The blockout's depth_m per zone (the Lagoon 2-4, the Nursery 1-3, the Forest 6-12, the Bommie 3-15, the Surge Channel 4-10, the Maze 8-14, the Flats 12-20, the Beach 0-3, the Blue Hole 20-60, the Wall 15-80).
_open_note: The reef is open to the sky: no rock ceilings; the shallows' tops are the surface.
_alarm_source: Blockout notes: 'Alarm regions: Reef (Lagoon, Nursery, Forest, Bommie, Maze) and Open (Flats, Beach, Hole, Wall).'
_flow_source: Blockout notes: 'the tide runs Lagoon -> Forest -> Flats -> Wall on the ebb and reverses on the flood every 4 minutes (the tide mill shows which).'
_current_source: 'The Surge Channel: a one-way current between the Bommie and the Wall: ride it (4 s).'
_diet_patch_source: The doc's beast table: the toad is eaten by the monk seal, the moray by sharks, the titan triggerfish by sharks, the Napoleon wrasse and the manta by the orca. The reef workbook lists no scavenger at all, so carrion goes to its opportunists (triggerfish, goatfish, spiny lobsters, the wrasse, the mangrove frogs): our call, noted in docs/REDTIDE_PROGRESS.md.
_species_patch_source: The doc's table: Clownfish 'Nothing while in its anemone'; Bobbit Worm 'Nothing'; Humpback 'Nothing'.
_species_add_source: Boss sheet: 'an orca matriarch (size 6) with a pod of three (size 5, 3,000 HP each)'.
_narrow_source: 'Coral erosion: each crown-of-thorns eats one staghorn segment per 90 s; a broken segment turns a corridor into a lane sharks can use.' The Matriarch's arena excludes 'the corridors, which are too narrow'. Size 5 and up keep out of the Forest until its staghorn is down to 70%.

allies.hostile_bark: Now the grey ones hate them too!

_allies_source: 'The dolphin pod follows the divers' centroid at 20-30 m while allied; rams any shark that enters 10 m of a diver; turns hostile for the match the moment a dolphin takes damage from a diver.'
_flora_rules_source: Flora sheet: Reacher coral 'grabs a diver who brushes it: held until cut free by a teammate or shot to 0 (400); grabs beasts and Raiders too and feeds on them'; Sea grape 'a diver eats a cluster: +10 HP, once per cluster'; Halimeda 'shatters loudly (4 noise) when walked on'.
_traps_source: 'Traps: a Reacher coral gate (1,000) closes a corridor and eats whatever it holds; the surge channel (1,000) flushes the Bommie's top.'

quest_altar.text: The drum goes back to the turtles' beach. The reef quiets: every diver's pockets fill with the Raiders' tribute.

_quest_source: 'Hidden quest: return the Shaman's drum to the sea turtle nesting beach.' The reward is ours (the doc gives none).

chum: Let the blood bring the big ones.
ally: Now the grey ones hate them too!
shark: To the coral head. The little fish will calm the sharks.
foreman: The sea's mother hears the drum.

_faction_source: The Reef Raiders' faction sheet: squad 'two Spear Divers, a Turtle Rider, a Sling Diver' plus the sheet's Netter; they hunt beasts for meat and shoot dolphins on purpose; the Shaman drums from the Wall (+aggression in 40 m for 20 s, sharks on the third beat, the Matriarch on the fifth).
